newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bufont seen in sponsored Brussels listing.
newsitem.headline: Bufont seen in sponsored Brussels listing.

text.p: Belgian brokerage joint venture Soges-Dewaay hopes to lead a Brussels listing of certificates in South African gold mines group Buffelsfontein Gold Mines Ltd, building on two other recent sponsored listings.

"We have done Avgold and Beatrix ...We hope to have Buffelsfontein quite soon as well," Soges-Dewaay director Claude Dandois told Reuters. He was speaking at a presentation of Beatrix, which listed on the Brussels Stock Exchange in the form of international depositary receipts on Monday.
Dandois said he hoped Buffelsfontein would follow in April.
